---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible defect in RunWeave
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Description

Describe what happened and why it is incorrect or unsafe.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest runbook, command sequence, or fixture that reproduces the issue. Remove secrets and private data.

## Environment

Include Python version, operating system, RunWeave version or commit, and whether the issue involves local files, SQLite state, subprocesses, or recovery.

## Expected and observed behavior

Explain the expected state, decision, reason code, exit code, or output, followed by what actually occurred.

## Evidence

Attach redacted logs or JSON output when useful. Do not attach credentials or private source code.
